title: 2" mattress pad
text: 2" mattress pad. Wow.  Who would have thought a 2" pad would make such a fabulous difference.  I have a queen size bed.  The pad fits all the way to edge on all four corners.  I am a larger person - 0x/1x... 5'7 - so I really didn't think that 2" would make that much difference.  I just didn't want the added height of the 4".  The cozy, softness is amazing. I find that I toss and turn less.  I would say if you're on the fence, try it.  It arrives in a manageable box (sucked down plastic) and easily unwraps (they include a handy, safe to use slicer).  I put it on the bed and let it rest while I washed the bedding.  All good.  But the time I had all the bedding clean (about 2 hours later)  it had fluffed right up.  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.

product_metadata.title: Lucid 3 Inch Mattress Topper Full - Gel Infused Memory Foam – Memory Foam Mattress Topper Full – Ventilated Design – CertiPur Certified Blue
features: PLUSH FEEL – Our memory foam mattress toppers are designed to enhance a mattress, making your sleep experience more soft. Enjoy three inches of plush memory foam that is light, airy, and responsive.
GEL INFUSION – This Lucid memory foam mattress topper is infused with gel to help dissipate heat and regulate body temperature for a more comfortable sleep environment
VENTILATED DESIGN – Our gel mattress toppers are designed with ventilation to help dissolve heat with constant airflow, perfect for those who sleep hot.
PROTECT YOUR BED – Protect the life of your memory foam topper with a waterproof mattress cover. All Lucid mattress protectors are designed to accommodate both a topper and mattress in one enclosure.
EASY TO SHIP – We design all our Lucid Full mattress toppers to ship from our home to yours in an easy-to-carry box. Unbox, unroll, and wait 24-48 hours for expansion.
description: At Lucid, we make beds for the whole family— because when you wake up feeling your best, your family gets the best version of you too. The Lucid 3 Inch Gel Memory Foam Mattress Topper is an affordable way to make a firm mattress plush. The three inches of responsive memory foam cradle your body with a soft “sink-in” feeling. The gel infusion in the bed topper helps dissipate heat and regulate body temperature for a more comfortable sleep climate. Designed to fit, a Full size mattress topper perfectly complements a Full mattress. Our Lucid mattress topper is CertiPur-US® Certified for safety and performance. And for shipping convenience, the topper is shipped directly to your door in an easy-to-carry box. Comfort awaits.
